# Code of Conduct

> 中文版：[CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Our commitment

The FenCun community is open to everyone. Whatever your race, ethnicity, colour, age, appearance, neurotype, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, language, beliefs, nationality, social origin, economic status, or education, if you take part in good faith and follow this code, you have an equal right to participate.

## Expected behaviour

- Engage with honesty and good faith; respect differing viewpoints and experiences
- Take responsibility for your words, actions, and contributions, and make amends when you cause harm
- Give and receive constructive feedback gracefully
- Remember that culture, background, and first language differ, and so does how a sentence lands

## Unacceptable behaviour

Doing, threatening, or promoting any of the following violates this code:

- **Harassment**: crossing a boundary after it has been made clear, or persisting after being asked to stop
- **Personal attacks**: insulting, demeaning, or contemptuous remarks toward a person or group
- **Discrimination and stereotyping**: judging someone's character or conduct by an immutable identity or trait
- **Sexualisation**: intimacy that is inappropriate in this community's context
- **Privacy violations**: sharing or exploiting someone's private information without permission
- **Endangerment**: committing, inciting, or threatening violence or other harm
- **False identity**: impersonating someone, or using impersonation to evade enforcement
- **Unsolicited promotion**: marketing or commercial content unrelated to the community
- **Unattributed contributions**: failing to credit the source of what you contribute

## Reporting

Contact the maintainer privately at the email published on [@MrBaoboer](https://github.com/MrBaoboer)'s GitHub profile. Do not open a public issue.

Every report is investigated, with the reporter's safety and confidentiality taking priority. Enforcement happens privately among the people involved; with everyone's consent, informing the wider community may be part of the resolution.

## Enforcement

The measure is chosen by how much harm the incident caused to the people involved and to the community. Severe cases may skip straight to a higher tier.

| Situation | Measure |
|---|---|
| A single or minor violation | A private written warning, stating what is expected going forward |
| A repeated violation, or a first more serious one | Warning plus a time-limited cooling-off period, which may restrict specific channels or interactions |
| Repeated violations after warnings, or one severe violation | Temporary suspension, with conditions for reinstatement |
| Persistently uncorrected, or severe enough that the community cannot be kept safe | Permanent ban |

This table is a guideline; it does not limit the maintainer's discretion to act in the community's best interest.

## Scope

This code applies in all community spaces, and whenever you formally represent the project elsewhere — using a project email address, posting on behalf of the project on social media, or attending an online or offline event as its representative.
